paragraphs.text:
“OK, Professor.’ Charlie glares at you. “We who live all our life 
in this land can never know its ways so well as those from other 
countries. We will search for the boy.” You and the others fall in 
behind your sullen hunting guide.

Make a Hard roll against Charlie’s Track: if she succeeds, go to 525; 
if not, go to 523.
